definition_en: to move quickly; to do something too fast; a sudden attack; a busy period
core_image: 人群或水流一下子朝一个方向猛冲
scene: 她抓起包就冲出了门。She grabbed her bag and rushed out of the door.
sceneCN: 这里 rush 是「冲」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她抓起包就冲出了门。

senses.title: Move quickly
senses.definition: to move with great speed
senses.definitionCN: 以极快的速度移动
senses.example: She rushed to the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她冲向车站。
senses.why: The core sense is sudden fast motion.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是突然的快速运动。

senses.title: Do too fast
senses.definition: to do something too quickly
senses.definitionCN: 过于仓促地做某事
senses.example: Don't rush the decision.
senses.exampleCN: 不要仓促作决定。
senses.why: Fast motion becomes hasty action.
senses.whyCN: 快速移动变成草率行事。

senses.title: Sudden attack
senses.definition: a sudden military attack
senses.definitionCN: 突然的军事攻击
senses.example: The soldiers rushed the gate at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们在黎明时冲向大门。
senses.why: Charging forward becomes an assault.
senses.whyCN: 向前冲变成进攻。

senses.title: Busy period
senses.definition: a busy period when many people move
senses.definitionCN: 许多人同时涌动的繁忙时段
senses.example: The morning rush fills every train.
senses.exampleCN: 早高峰让每列火车都挤满人。
senses.why: The movement becomes a crowded time.
senses.whyCN: 运动变成拥挤的时段。

intro.en: Rush comes from Old French ruser, to drive back or charge.
intro.cn: rush 源自古法语 ruser，意为击退、猛冲。

items.en: Ruser means to drive back or push.
items.cn: ruser 意为击退或推挤。

items.en: Russher means to charge forward.
items.cn: russher 意为向前猛冲。

items.en: Rushen covers people and water.
items.cn: rushen 兼指人与水流。

items.en: Rush extends to hasty action.
items.cn: rush 扩展到仓促行事。

items.en: Rush hour names the busiest travel time.
items.cn: rush hour 指最繁忙的通行时段。

note.en: Rush is fast movement; rust is a red coat on iron.
note.cn: rush 是快速冲撞，rust 则是铁上的锈。

normalIntro.en: Rush is speed with little time to think.
normalIntro.cn: rush 是快得来不及思考的速度。

normal.en: People rush for the last train.
normal.cn: 人们冲向末班车。

normal.en: Do not rush your homework.
normal.cn: 不要急着赶作业。

normal.en: The water rushed over the rocks.
normal.cn: 水从岩石上冲过。

normal.en: The rush hour starts at five.
normal.cn: 高峰时段五点开始。

normal.en: They rushed through lunch to catch the bus.
normal.cn: 他们匆匆吃完午饭去赶公交。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd pouring through a narrow gate.
abstract.cn: 想象人群从窄门涌出。

abstract.en: Imagine a river after heavy rain.
abstract.cn: 想象暴雨后的河水。

abstract.en: Think of a clock hand moving too fast.
abstract.cn: 想象钟表的指针转得太快。

examples.en: The crowd rushed toward the open doors.
examples.cn: 人群朝敞开的大门冲去。

examples.en: He rushed his speech and made mistakes.
examples.cn: 他讲得太仓促，出了错。

examples.en: The morning rush makes the roads slow.
examples.cn: 早高峰让道路变得缓慢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rush」读音像「如射」：像箭一样射出去，就是「冲、匆忙」。

root: 源自古法语 ruser（击退、推挤），核心义「猛然向前冲」，再引申为仓促行事与高峰时段。

sensesIntro.en: Rush means to move fast, to act too quickly, a sudden attack, or a busy period.
sensesIntro.cn: rush 意为猛冲、仓促行事、突袭，或繁忙高峰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sudden surge toward something.
core.cn: 核心意象：一股力量突然涌向某处。

branches.en: The base sense is fast movement.
branches.cn: 基础义是快速移动。

branches.en: Fast movement becomes hasty action.
branches.cn: 快速移动变成仓促行事。

branches.en: Charging becomes a military attack.
branches.cn: 向前冲变成军事突袭。

branches.en: Movement becomes a crowded time.
branches.cn: 运动变成拥挤时段。

branches.en: The daily rush is many people moving fast.
branches.cn: 日常高峰就是许多人同时快速移动。

intro.en: Rush is a borrowing from Old French.
intro.cn: rush 是从古法语借入的词。

latinIntro.en: Rush has no direct Latin root in English use.
latinIntro.cn: rush 在英语用法中没有直接拉丁词根。

items.example: Ruser is the source of rush.
items.exampleCN: ruser 是 rush 的来源。
rushed 描述仓促完成的工作。

definition_zh: 悲伤的；难过的；令人难过的；可悲的
definition_en: feeling unhappy; showing sorrow; making people feel unhappy; unfortunate and regrettable
core_image: 低着头、眼角含泪的一张脸
scene: 听到那个消息后，她显得很悲伤。She looked sad after hearing the news.
sceneCN: 这里 sad 是「悲伤的、难过的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：听到那个消息后，她显得很悲伤。

pos.zh: 令人难过的；令人悲伤的

senses.title: Feeling unhappy
senses.definition: feeling unhappy because something painful has happened
senses.definitionCN: 因发生痛苦的事而感到不快乐的
senses.example: She looked sad when she heard the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到这个消息时，她显得很悲伤。
senses.why: The core sense is low spirits inside a person.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是人内心低落的情绪。

senses.title: Causing sorrow
senses.titleCN: 令人难过的；令人悲伤的
senses.definition: making people feel unhappy or full of sorrow
senses.definitionCN: 使人感到不快或充满悲伤的
senses.example: It was a sad story about a lost child.
senses.exampleCN: 那是一个关于走失孩子的悲伤故事。
senses.why: The feeling spreads from people to what causes it.
senses.whyCN: 情绪从人扩展到引起情绪的事物。

senses.title: Regrettable
senses.definition: unfortunate and disappointing in a way that brings sorrow
senses.definitionCN: 不幸且令人失望、使人感到悲伤的
senses.example: It is sad that so many people were left out.
senses.exampleCN: 这么多人被排除在外，实在令人遗憾。
senses.why: Sorrow becomes a judgment on a situation.
senses.whyCN: 悲伤转为对某种处境的评判。

intro.en: Sad comes from Old English sæd, which first meant sated or weary.
intro.cn: sad 源自古英语 sæd，最初意为「吃饱的、疲倦的」。

items.en: Sæd means sated or weary.
items.cn: 古英语 sæd 意为吃饱的或疲倦的。

items.en: Fullness turns into weariness of spirit.
items.cn: 「饱足」引申为精神上的厌倦。

items.en: Sad comes to mean sorrowful.
items.cn: 中古英语中 sad 转为「悲伤的」。

items.en: Sad settles as the common word for sorrow.
items.cn: 近代早期英语中 sad 固定为表示悲伤的常用词。

items.en: Sad describes people, news, and situations.
items.cn: 现代英语中 sad 可形容人、消息与处境。

note.en: Sad means sorrowful; said is the past of say.
note.cn: sad 是悲伤的，said 则是 say 的过去式。

normalIntro.en: Sad appears whenever something painful or disappointing happens.
normalIntro.cn: 当痛苦或失望的事情发生时，就会用到 sad。

normal.en: She felt sad when her friend moved away.
normal.cn: 朋友搬走时，她感到很难过。

normal.en: The film has a sad ending.
normal.cn: 这部电影有一个悲伤的结局。

normal.en: He gave a sad smile and said nothing.
normal.cn: 他悲伤地笑了笑，什么也没说。

normal.en: It is sad to see the old shop close.
normal.cn: 看到老店关门，令人难过。

normal.en: The letter brought sad news from home.
normal.cn: 这封信带来了家里的悲伤消息。

abstract.en: Picture a face with lowered eyes and a heavy heart.
abstract.cn: 想象一张低垂双眼、心情沉重的脸。

abstract.en: Imagine rain falling on an empty playground.
abstract.cn: 想象雨落在空无一人的操场上。

abstract.en: Think of a song that slows down at the end.
abstract.cn: 想象一首在结尾放慢的歌曲。

examples.en: She was sad to leave her childhood home.
examples.cn: 离开童年的家让她很难过。

examples.en: The sad news spread through the village.
examples.cn: 这个令人难过的消息传遍了村庄。

examples.en: It is sad that the concert was cancelled.
examples.cn: 音乐会被取消，实在令人遗憾。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「sad」谐音「散的」：曲终人散，心里难免悲伤。

root: 源自古英语 sæd（吃饱的、厌倦的），由「饱足而生倦」引申为「心情低落、悲伤」。

sensesIntro.en: Sad means feeling unhappy, causing sorrow, or being unfortunate and regrettable.
sensesIntro.cn: sad 意为感到不快、令人悲伤的，或不幸而令人遗憾的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face lowered by sorrow.
core.cn: 核心意象：因悲伤而低垂的一张脸。

branches.en: The base sense is inner unhappiness.
branches.cn: 基础义是内心的不快。

branches.en: Feeling spreads to what causes it.
branches.cn: 情绪扩展到引起它的对象。

branches.en: Sorrow becomes a judgment on events.
branches.cn: 悲伤转为对事件的评判。

branches.en: A person and a story can both be sad.
branches.cn: 人与故事都可以是悲伤的。

branches.en: Sad news and a sad outcome overlap.
branches.cn: 悲伤的消息与可悲的结果相互重叠。

intro.en: Sad is a Germanic word that builds a small family with -ly, -ness, and -en.
intro.cn: sad 是日耳曼语词，通过 -ly、-ness 与 -en 构成一个小词族。

latinIntro.en: Sad has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sæd.
latinIntro.cn: sad 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 sæd。

items.example: She spoke sadly about the past.

items.exampleCN: 这个消息让大家很悲伤。
一只眼神悲伤的狗在外面等候。
那位面带悲伤的男子什么也没说。

definition_en: in a sad way; in a way that shows regret; unfortunately
core_image: 低声说话、缓缓摇头的悲伤神情
scene: 她悲伤地摇了摇头。She shook her head sadly.
sceneCN: 这里 sadly 是「悲伤地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她悲伤地摇了摇头。

senses.title: In a sad way
senses.definition: with feelings of sorrow or unhappiness
senses.definitionCN: 带着悲伤或不快的情绪
senses.example: She looked sadly at the old photograph.
senses.exampleCN: 她悲伤地看着那张旧照片。
senses.why: The suffix -ly turns the feeling into a manner.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ly 把情绪转成做事的方式。

senses.title: With regret
senses.definition: with a feeling of disappointment or regret
senses.definitionCN: 带着失望或遗憾的心情
senses.example: Sadly, the train had already left.
senses.exampleCN: 遗憾的是，火车已经开走了。
senses.why: Regret colors the speaker's comment on a fact.
senses.whyCN: 遗憾给说话人对事实的评论染上色彩。

senses.title: Unfortunately
senses.definition: used to say that something is unfortunate
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示某事不幸或令人惋惜
senses.example: Sadly, many families lost their homes.
senses.exampleCN: 不幸的是，许多家庭失去了家园。
senses.why: The sentence adverb marks bad news.
senses.whyCN: 句子副词用来标记坏消息。

intro.en: Sadly is sad plus the adverb ending -ly, from Old English -lice.
intro.cn: sadly 由 sad 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，-ly 源自古英语 -lice。

items.en: The ending -lice forms adverbs of manner.
items.cn: 古英语词尾 -lice 构成方式副词。

items.en: The ending becomes -ly in everyday use.
items.cn: 中古英语中该词尾在日常使用中变为 -ly。

items.en: Sadly describes how someone speaks or moves.
items.cn: sadly 描述某人说话或动作的方式。

items.en: Sadly also comments on unfortunate facts.
items.cn: sadly 也可评述不幸的事实。

items.en: The pattern is adjective plus -ly.
items.cn: 构词模式是形容词加 -ly。

note.en: Sadly means with sorrow; badly means in a poor way.
note.cn: sadly 是悲伤地，badly 则是糟糕地。

entries.definition: in a poor or harmful way
in a wild or very eager way
by bad luck or in a sad way

normalIntro.en: Sadly tells how something is done or comments on bad news.
normalIntro.cn: sadly 既说明事情如何发生，也可用来评论坏消息。

normal.en: She smiled sadly and closed the door.
normal.cn: 她悲伤地笑了笑，关上了门。

normal.en: He spoke sadly about his old school.
normal.cn: 他悲伤地谈起自己的母校。

normal.en: Sadly, the concert was cancelled.
normal.cn: 遗憾的是，音乐会被取消了。

normal.en: The dog waited sadly by the gate.
normal.cn: 狗悲伤地在门边等候。

normal.en: Sadly, few people came to the meeting.
normal.cn: 不幸的是，来开会的人很少。

abstract.en: Picture a person speaking in a low, slow voice.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人用低沉缓慢的声音说话。

abstract.en: Imagine a head shaking slowly from side to side.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗头缓缓地左右摇动。

abstract.en: Think of a sigh that comes before bad news.
abstract.cn: 想象坏消息到来前的一声叹息。

examples.en: She looked sadly at the empty chair.
examples.cn: 她悲伤地看着那把空椅子。

examples.en: Sadly, the museum closed last year.
examples.cn: 遗憾的是，博物馆去年关闭了。

examples.en: He smiled sadly and said goodbye.
examples.cn: 他悲伤地微笑着道别。

dict_mnemonic.text: sad 加副词后缀 -ly，表示「以悲伤的方式」，就是 sadly。

root: 由形容词 sad 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，核心义「以悲伤或遗憾的方式」。

sensesIntro.en: Sadly means in a sorrowful manner, with regret, or unfortunately.
sensesIntro.cn: sadly 意为以悲伤的方式、带着遗憾，或不幸地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sorrowful voice and a slow shake of the head.
core.cn: 核心意象：悲伤的嗓音与缓慢的摇头。

branches.en: The base sense is the manner of sorrow.
branches.cn: 基础义是带悲伤的行为方式。

branches.en: Disappointment adds a tone of regret.
branches.cn: 失望为语气添上遗憾。

branches.en: The adverb comments on an unfortunate fact.
branches.cn: 副词用来评述不幸的事实。

branches.en: Sorrowful manner and regretful tone overlap.
branches.cn: 悲伤的方式与遗憾的语气相互重叠。

branches.en: Regret and bad news often appear together.
branches.cn: 遗憾与坏消息常常同时出现。

intro.en: Sadly is built from sad plus the native English adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: sadly 由 sad 加英语本族副词词尾 -ly 构成。

latinIntro.en: Sadly has no Latin root; its ending descends from Old English -lice.
latinIntro.cn: sadly 没有拉丁词根，其词尾来自古英语 -lice。

items.example: Her sadness was easy to see.
items.exampleCN: 她的悲伤很容易看出来。
这个故事让孩子们很悲伤。
那个眼神悲伤的女孩独自等候。

items.example: A sad-faced officer read the letter.
items.exampleCN: 一位面带悲伤的官员读了那封信。

definition_zh: 悲伤；难过；令人悲伤的事
definition_en: the feeling of being sad; the quality of showing sorrow; a sad event or fact
core_image: 胸口发沉、眼泪将落未落的感觉
scene: 她眼中流露出深深的悲伤。There was deep sadness in her eyes.
sceneCN: 这里 sadness 是「悲伤、难过」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她眼中流露出深深的悲伤。

senses.title: The feeling of sorrow
senses.definition: the feeling of being unhappy and sorrowful
senses.definitionCN: 不快乐而又悲伤的感受
senses.example: A wave of sadness washed over him.
senses.exampleCN: 一阵悲伤涌上他的心头。
senses.why: The core sense is the inner state of sorrow.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是内心悲伤的状态。

senses.title: Outward sign of sorrow
senses.definition: the quality of looking or sounding sorrowful
senses.definitionCN: 神情或声音中流露出的悲伤
senses.example: There was sadness in her voice.
senses.exampleCN: 她的声音里带着悲伤。
senses.why: The inner state becomes visible to others.
senses.whyCN: 内心的状态变得让旁人看得见。

senses.title: A sad fact
senses.definition: something that makes people feel sorrow
senses.definitionCN: 使人感到悲伤的事情
senses.example: The sadness of the story stayed with me.
senses.exampleCN: 这个故事的悲伤一直留在我心里。
senses.why: A state becomes a fact that can be named.
senses.whyCN: 状态变成可以被指称的事实。

intro.en: Sadness is sad plus the noun ending -ness, from Old English -nes.
intro.cn: sadness 由 sad 加名词词尾 -ness 构成，-ness 源自古英语 -nes。

items.en: The ending -nes forms nouns of state.
items.cn: 古英语词尾 -nes 构成表示状态的名词。

items.en: Sad still carries the sense of weary fullness.
items.cn: 当时的 sad 仍带有「饱足而倦」的含义。

items.en: Sadness names the state of being sorrowful.
items.cn: sadness 指悲伤的状态。

items.en: The word appears in poetry and letters.
items.cn: 这个词出现在诗歌与书信中。

items.en: Sadness covers feelings, signs, and sad facts.
items.cn: sadness 涵盖感受、表现与令人悲伤的事实。

note.en: Sadness is the state; sorrow is its deeper form.
note.cn: sadness 是悲伤的状态，sorrow 则是更深的悲痛。

normalIntro.en: Sadness names the feeling of sorrow and the signs it leaves.
normalIntro.cn: sadness 指悲伤的感受，也指它留下的种种表现。

normal.en: A deep sadness filled the empty house.
normal.cn: 深深的悲伤充满了空荡的房子。

normal.en: She could not hide her sadness.
normal.cn: 她无法掩饰自己的悲伤。

normal.en: There was sadness in his quiet voice.
normal.cn: 他平静的声音里带着悲伤。

normal.en: The sadness of the ending surprised us.
normal.cn: 结局的悲伤让我们感到意外。

normal.en: Music can express sadness without words.
normal.cn: 音乐可以不用语言表达悲伤。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy weight resting on the chest.
abstract.cn: 想象胸口压着一块沉重的石头。

abstract.en: Imagine tears that stop before they fall.
abstract.cn: 想象泪水将落未落。

abstract.en: Think of an empty room after a farewell.
abstract.cn: 想象告别之后空荡的房间。

examples.en: His sadness was clear to everyone.
examples.cn: 他的悲伤大家都看得出来。

examples.en: She wrote a poem about loss and sadness.
examples.cn: 她写了一首关于失去与悲伤的诗。

examples.en: The sadness of the news spread across the town.
examples.cn: 这个消息带来的悲伤传遍了小镇。

dict_mnemonic.text: sad 加名词后缀 -ness，表示「悲伤的状态」，就是 sadness。

root: 由形容词 sad 加名词词尾 -ness 构成，核心义「悲伤的状态及其表现」。

sensesIntro.en: Sadness means the feeling of sorrow, its outward signs, or a sad fact.
sensesIntro.cn: sadness 意为悲伤的感受、悲伤的表现，或令人悲伤的事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy feeling behind the eyes.
core.cn: 核心意象：双眼里沉甸甸的感受。

branches.en: The base sense is the inner feeling.
branches.cn: 基础义是内心的感受。

branches.en: Feeling becomes visible in face and voice.
branches.cn: 感受在神情与声音中显现。

branches.en: Sorrow becomes a fact that can be named.
branches.cn: 悲伤变成可以被指称的事实。

branches.en: Inner sorrow and outward grief belong together.
branches.cn: 内心的悲伤与外在的哀伤相互关联。

branches.en: Visible grief and sad events often overlap.
branches.cn: 可见的哀伤与悲伤的事件常常重叠。

intro.en: Sadness is sad plus -ness, one of the most productive noun endings in English.
intro.cn: sadness 由 sad 加 -ness 构成，-ness 是英语中构词力很强的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Sadness has no Latin root; both sad and -ness are native English elements.
latinIntro.cn: sadness 没有拉丁词根；sad 与 -ness 都是英语本族成分。

items.exampleCN: 这个消息让全家很悲伤。

items.example: The room felt sadder at night.
It was the saddest day of the year.
items.exampleCN: 那是一年中最悲伤的一天。

items.example: A sad-eyed child stood at the door.
items.exampleCN: 一个眼神悲伤的孩子站在门口。

senses.whyCN: 古老的法律义把过错视为需要偿还的债。

intro.en: Satisfaction comes from Latin satisfactio, from satis enough and facere to make.
intro.cn: satisfaction 来自拉丁语 satisfactio，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成。

items.en: Satis means enough.
items.cn: satis 意为足够。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为做或制造。

items.en: Satisfactio means making amends.
items.cn: satisfactio 意为作出补偿。

items.en: The word enters French legal use.
items.cn: 该词进入法语法律用语。

items.en: It names both contentment and compensation.
items.cn: 现代英语中它兼指满意与补偿。

note.en: Satisfaction is the feeling of enough; saturation means being full to the limit.
note.cn: satisfaction 是满足感，saturation 则是达到饱和。

entries.definition: the state of being completely full
a feeling of not being pleased
quiet happiness with what one has
the achievement of a need or aim

normalIntro.en: Satisfaction is what you feel when something is finally enough.
normalIntro.cn: satisfaction 就是事情终于「足够」时的感受。

normal.en: She looked at the finished work with satisfaction.
normal.cn: 她满意地看着完成的作品。

normal.en: Customer satisfaction has risen this year.
normal.cn: 今年顾客满意度上升了。

normal.en: The matter was settled to everyone's satisfaction.
normal.cn: 这件事以人人满意的方式解决了。

normal.en: He gets great satisfaction from teaching.
normal.cn: 他从教学中获得极大满足。

normal.en: The court demanded satisfaction of the debt.
normal.cn: 法院要求清偿这笔债务。

abstract.en: Picture an empty cup filled to the brim.
abstract.cn: 想象一个空杯被倒到杯沿。

abstract.en: Imagine a debt crossed out at last.
abstract.cn: 想象一笔债务终于被划掉。

abstract.en: Think of a wrong balanced by a fair payment.
abstract.cn: 把过错想成由公平偿付来平衡。

examples.en: He nodded in satisfaction at the result.
examples.cn: 他对结果满意地点了点头。

examples.en: The workers expressed satisfaction with the new rules.
examples.cn: 工人们对新规定表示满意。

examples.en: The injured party sought satisfaction in court.
examples.cn: 受害方在法庭上寻求补偿。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁组合
dict_mnemonic.text: satis（足够）+ factio（做）= satisfaction，把该做的做到足够，就有了「满足」。

root: satisfaction 源自拉丁语 satisfactio，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）组合，原义为「做到足够、作出补偿」。

sensesIntro.en: Satisfaction is contentment, the fulfilment of a claim, or compensation for a wrong.
sensesIntro.cn: satisfaction 指满足感、对要求或债务的履行，或对过错的补偿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cup filled to the brim and set at rest.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯子被倒满，安然放下。

branches.en: The base sense is the feeling of enough.
branches.cn: 基础义是「足够」带来的感受。

branches.en: Enough turns into fulfilling what is owed.
branches.cn: 「足够」转化为履行所欠之物。

branches.en: A wrong becomes a debt to be paid.
branches.cn: 过错被看作需要偿还的债。

branches.en: Settling a claim brings contentment.
branches.cn: 清偿索赔带来满足感。

branches.en: Fulfilment and compensation both close an obligation.
branches.cn: 履行与补偿都了结一项义务。

intro.en: Satisfaction belongs to the satisf- family built on satis and facere.
intro.cn: satisfaction 属于由 satis 与 facere 构成的 satisf- 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin satis, facere, and satisfacere explain satisfaction and satisfy.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 satis、facere 与 satisfacere 解释了 satisfaction 与 satisfy。

items.exampleCN: 这顿饭让每个人都很满足。
这是一顿令人满足的饭。

latinEntries.exampleCN: satis 是 satisfaction 的开头。

definition_zh: 使满意；满足；符合；使信服
definition_en: to make someone pleased or content; to fulfil a need or desire; to meet a requirement; to convince someone
core_image: 把对方需要的东西刚好给足
scene: 优质服务能满足顾客。Good service can satisfy customers.
sceneCN: 这里 satisfy 是「使满意」（第 1 个义项）；句意：优质服务能满足顾客。

senses.title: To please someone
senses.definition: to make someone feel pleased or content
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到愉快或满足
senses.example: The gift satisfied the child.
senses.exampleCN: 这份礼物让这个孩子很满意。
senses.why: The base sense is giving someone enough to be happy.
senses.whyCN: 基础义是给对方足够的东西使其高兴。

senses.title: To fulfil a need
senses.definition: to provide enough to meet a need, desire, or appetite
senses.definitionCN: 提供足以满足需要、欲望或胃口的东西
senses.example: A snack will satisfy your hunger.
senses.exampleCN: 一份点心就能让你不饿。
senses.why: A need is like an empty space that must be filled.
senses.whyCN: 需要就像一个必须被填满的空缺。

senses.title: To meet a requirement
senses.definition: to meet a rule, condition, or standard
senses.definitionCN: 达到规则、条件或标准
senses.example: The team must satisfy the entry rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍必须符合参赛规则。
senses.why: The idea of enough applies to formal conditions.
senses.whyCN: 「足够」的观念适用于正式条件。

senses.title: To convince
senses.definition: to give someone enough proof to remove doubt
senses.definitionCN: 提供足以消除疑问的证据
senses.example: The evidence satisfied the jury.
senses.exampleCN: 证据使陪审团信服了。
senses.why: Proof fills the space of doubt until nothing is left to question.
senses.whyCN: 证据填满疑问的空间，直到无可质疑。

intro.en: Satisfy comes from Latin satisfacere, from satis enough and facere to make.
intro.cn: satisfy 来自拉丁语 satisfacere，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成。

items.en: Satis means enough.
items.cn: satis 意为足够。

items.en: Facere means to make or do.
items.cn: facere 意为做。

items.en: Satisfacere means to make enough.
items.cn: satisfacere 意为做到足够。

items.en: Satisfier carries the sense of paying a debt.
items.cn: satisfier 带有偿还债务之义。

items.en: Satisfy means to please, fulfil, or convince.
items.cn: 现代英语中 satisfy 意为使满意、满足或使信服。

note.en: Satisfy means to give enough; satiate means to fill to excess.
note.cn: satisfy 是给足，satiate 则是过度填满。

entries.definition: to fill beyond what is wanted
to satisfy fully, often too much
to carry out a need or promise

normalIntro.en: Satisfy works for people, needs, rules, and doubts alike.
normalIntro.cn: satisfy 的对象可以是人、需要、规则或疑问。

normal.en: The answer did not satisfy the teacher.
normal.cn: 这个答案没能让老师满意。

normal.en: He ate bread to satisfy his hunger.
normal.cn: 他吃面包充饥。

normal.en: The product satisfies all safety standards.
normal.cn: 该产品符合所有安全标准。

normal.en: She satisfied the judges that she was right.
normal.cn: 她使评委相信她是对的。

normal.en: Are you satisfied with the service?
normal.cn: 你对服务满意吗？

abstract.en: Picture a cup filled exactly to the right level.
abstract.cn: 想象杯子被倒到恰到好处的高度。

abstract.en: Imagine a lock clicking shut on the last number.
abstract.cn: 想象密码锁在最后一个数字咔哒合上。

abstract.en: Think of doubt melting once proof arrives.
abstract.cn: 想象证据到来后疑问随之消融。

examples.en: It is impossible to satisfy everyone.
examples.cn: 不可能让所有人都满意。

examples.en: The meal satisfied our appetite.
examples.cn: 这顿饭满足了我们的胃口。

examples.en: Candidates must satisfy the language requirement.
examples.cn: 考生必须符合语言要求。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁组合
dict_mnemonic.text: satis（足够）+ fy（使…）= satisfy（使足够、使满足），同族词还有 satisfaction 与 satisfactory。

root: satisfy 源自拉丁语 satisfacere，由 satis（足够）与 facere（做）构成，意为「做到足够」。

sensesIntro.en: Satisfy means to please, fulfil a need, meet a standard, or convince.
sensesIntro.cn: satisfy 意为使满意、满足需要、符合标准，或使信服。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: giving exactly enough to fill a need.
core.cn: 核心意象：给出恰好的量来填满需要。

branches.en: The base sense is making someone pleased.
branches.cn: 基础义是使某人高兴。

branches.en: A need is an empty space to fill.
branches.cn: 需要是一个待填满的空缺。

branches.en: Rules define what counts as enough.
branches.cn: 规则界定何为足够。

branches.en: Proof fills the space of doubt.
branches.cn: 证据填满疑问的空间。

branches.en: Pleasing someone often means meeting their need.
branches.cn: 让人满意常常意味着满足其需要。

intro.en: Satisfy is the verb at the centre of the satisf- family.
intro.cn: satisfy 是 satisf- 词族的核心动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin satis and facere combine into satisfacere, the source of satisfy.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 satis 与 facere 组合成 satisfacere，即 satisfy 的源头。

items.meaning: to give enough and make content

items.exampleCN: 这个计划符合每个条件。

items.meaning: pleased or having met a need
items.example: We are satisfied with the answer.

items.exampleCN: 这是一次令人满足的经历。
许多需求仍未得到满足。

latinEntries.example: Satis is the first element of satisfy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: satis 是 satisfy 的第一个成分。
facere 在英语动词中变成 -fy。

latinEntries.example: Satisfacere is the direct source of satisfy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: satisfacere 是 satisfy 的直接源头。
satisfactus 是 satisfied 的前身。

definition_en: to keep safe from harm, to use less, or to put money aside
core_image: 救生员跃入泳池，把孩子托出水面
scene: 泳池边，救生员跳入水中救起孩子。The lifeguard saved the child from drowning.
sceneCN: 这里 save 是「挽救」（第 1 个义项）；句意：救生员把孩子从溺水中救了出来。

senses.title: Rescue from harm
senses.definition: to keep someone or something safe from danger or harm
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物免于危险或伤害
senses.example: The doctor saved the boy's life.
senses.exampleCN: 医生救了男孩的命。
senses.why: The oldest sense is bringing someone out of danger.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是把人从危险中带出来。

senses.title: Use less
senses.definition: to avoid wasting money, time, or resources
senses.definitionCN: 避免浪费金钱、时间或资源
senses.example: Taking the train saves time.
senses.exampleCN: 坐火车能节省时间。
senses.why: Rescuing a resource from waste becomes saving it.
senses.whyCN: 把资源从浪费中救出，就变成节省。

senses.title: Put money aside
senses.definition: to keep money for future use
senses.definitionCN: 把钱留作将来使用
senses.example: She saves a little every month.
senses.exampleCN: 她每月存一点钱。
senses.why: Money kept safe for later is money saved.
senses.whyCN: 为以后安全留存的钱就是储蓄。

senses.title: Store a file
senses.definition: to store work in a computer so it can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把工作内容存入电脑以便以后使用
senses.example: Remember to save the document.
senses.exampleCN: 记得保存文档。
senses.why: Digital storage keeps work safe from loss.
senses.whyCN: 数字存储让工作成果免于丢失。

senses.title: Spare someone
senses.definition: to prevent someone from having to do something unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 使某人不必做不愉快的事
senses.example: I will save you the trouble.
senses.exampleCN: 我会省去你的麻烦。
senses.why: Spared effort is effort saved.
senses.whyCN: 省去的力气就是被节省的力气。

intro.en: Save comes from Latin salvare, to make safe, through Old French sauver.
intro.cn: save 经古法语 sauver，源自拉丁语 salvare（使安全）。

items.en: Salvare means to make safe or to rescue.
items.cn: salvare 意为使安全或拯救。

items.en: Salvus means safe and uninjured.
items.cn: salvus 意为安全无恙的。

items.en: Sauver carried the sense of rescuing and sparing.
items.cn: sauver 兼具拯救与省下之义。

items.en: Saven added the sense of keeping money.
items.cn: saven 增加了存钱的含义。

items.en: Save extends to time, files, and effort.
items.cn: 现代英语中 save 扩展到时间、文件和精力。

note.en: Save is compared with similar spellings and with words for rescuing or keeping.
note.cn: 把 save 与形近词以及表示拯救或保留的词作比较。

entries.definition: to keep something in good condition

normalIntro.en: Save can be remembered through its sense of keeping safe.
normalIntro.cn: 可以通过「保持安全」这一核心意思记住 save。

normal.en: Save and safe share the same opening sound and meaning.
normal.cn: save 与 safe 开头音相同，意思也相通。

normal.en: Saving money keeps it safe for another day.
normal.cn: 存钱就是把钱安全留到以后用。

normal.en: A lifeguard saves a swimmer, while a saver saves cash.
normal.cn: 救生员救人，储蓄者存钱，都是 save。

normal.en: Press save before closing the document.
normal.cn: 关闭文档前按下保存键。

normal.en: The past form saved is made by adding d.
normal.cn: 过去式 saved 只需在词尾加 d。

abstract.en: To save is to give something a second chance.
abstract.cn: 拯救就是给某物第二次机会。

abstract.en: Every saved minute is a minute returned to you.
abstract.cn: 每一分钟节省下来的时间都是还给你的时间。

abstract.en: Saving links the present self with the future self.
abstract.cn: 储蓄把现在的自己与未来的自己连接起来。

examples.en: The new system saves the company a lot of money.
examples.cn: 新系统为公司节省了大量资金。

examples.en: He saved enough to buy a small car.
examples.cn: 他攒够了钱买一辆小车。

examples.en: Please save your work before the computer restarts.
examples.cn: 电脑重启前请保存你的工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: save 与 safe（安全的）同源，核心是「使安全」：救人、省资源、存钱、存文件都是让东西不丢失。

root: 源自拉丁语 salvare（使安全），与 salvus（安全的）同源，核心义「使免于损失或危险」。

sensesIntro.en: Save means to rescue, to use less, to put money aside, to store a file, or to spare someone trouble.
sensesIntro.cn: save 意为拯救、节省、储蓄、保存文件，或省去某人的麻烦。

core.en: To keep someone or something safe from loss.
core.cn: 使某人或某物免于损失。

branches.en: The core act of rescuing from harm.
branches.cn: 从危险中救出的核心行为。

branches.en: Resources kept from being wasted.
branches.cn: 使资源免于浪费。

branches.en: Money kept safe for future needs.
branches.cn: 为将来需要而安全保留的钱。

branches.en: Computer work stored against loss.
branches.cn: 防止丢失而存储的电脑成果。

branches.en: Trouble removed from someone.
branches.cn: 为某人省去的麻烦。

intro.en: Save has a broad family built on the idea of safety.
intro.cn: save 有一个围绕「安全」概念扩展的大家族。

latinIntro.en: Latin salvare and salvus lie behind the English family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 salvare 与 salvus 是这一英语词族的来源。

items.meaning: a person or thing that saves

items.example: The change gave us a saving of ten pounds.
items.exampleCN: 这一改动让我们省了十英镑。

items.example: Her savings are in the bank.

definition_en: to speak words, to express something, or to give a stated meaning
core_image: 会议上一个人举起手，准备说出自己的看法
scene: 会议上，他举手要求发言。He raised his hand to say something.
sceneCN: 这里 say 是「说」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他举手想说点什么。

senses.title: Speak words
senses.definition: to speak words in order to express something
senses.definitionCN: 说出话语以表达某事
senses.example: She said she would come later.
senses.exampleCN: 她说她会晚点来。
senses.why: The basic sense is producing speech.
senses.whyCN: 基本义是发出话语。

senses.title: Show in writing
senses.definition: of a sign or text, to show or state something
senses.definitionCN: 指标牌或文字显示、写明某事
senses.example: The notice says the shop is closed.
senses.exampleCN: 告示上写着商店关门。
senses.why: Written words speak to the reader.
senses.whyCN: 书面文字也在向读者说话。

senses.title: For example
senses.definition: used to introduce an example or an approximate amount
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出例子或大概的数量
senses.example: Take an apple, say, and cut it in half.
senses.exampleCN: 比如说拿一个苹果，把它切成两半。
senses.why: The speaker says a possible case aloud.
senses.whyCN: 说话者把一种可能情况说出来。

senses.title: Right to speak
senses.definition: the chance or right to express an opinion
senses.definitionCN: 表达意见的机会或权利
senses.example: Everyone should have a say in the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都应对这个计划有发言权。
senses.why: The act of saying becomes the right to be heard.
senses.whyCN: 说的行为转化为被倾听的权利。

intro.en: Say is a native English word from Old English secgan, with Germanic roots.
intro.cn: say 是英语本族词，源自古英语 secgan，属于日耳曼语源。

items.en: Sagjan meant to tell or to state.
items.cn: sagjan 意为讲述或陈述。

items.en: Secgan meant to say or to tell.
items.cn: secgan 意为说或告诉。

items.en: Seien simplified the spelling and kept the sound.
items.cn: seien 简化了拼写并保留读音。

items.en: Say became the standard form for speaking.
items.cn: say 成为表示说话的标准形式。

items.en: Fixed phrases such as needless to say grew common.
items.cn: needless to say 等固定短语逐渐常见。

note.en: Say is compared with look-alike spellings and with other speech verbs.
note.cn: 把 say 与形近拼写以及其他言说动词作比较。

entries.definition: to kill in a violent way

normalIntro.en: Say is short, common, and changes sharply in the past tense.
normalIntro.cn: say 简短常用，过去式变化不规则。

normal.en: Say is one syllable, like the quick act of speaking.
normal.cn: say 是一个音节，正像说话这个快速动作。

normal.en: The past form said rhymes with red.
normal.cn: 过去式 said 与 red 押韵。

normal.en: Say hello and say goodbye are two daily phrases.
normal.cn: say hello 和 say goodbye 是两个日常短语。

normal.en: A saying is a short sentence people often repeat.
normal.cn: saying 是人们常重复的短句。

normal.en: Have a say means having a voice in a decision.
normal.cn: have a say 意为在决定中有发言权。

abstract.en: To say is to turn a thought into sound.
abstract.cn: 说就是把想法变成声音。

abstract.en: A word said today may echo for years.
abstract.cn: 今天说出的一句话可能回响多年。

abstract.en: Saying and listening are two halves of one conversation.
abstract.cn: 说与听是同一场对话的两半。

examples.en: What did she say about the meeting?
examples.cn: 她关于会议说了什么？

examples.en: The sign says no parking.
examples.cn: 牌子上写着禁止停车。

examples.en: Everyone will have a say in the final choice.
examples.cn: 每个人在最终选择中都会有发言权。

dict_mnemonic.text: say 是英语本族词，记 its 不规则变化：say, says, said；再记短语 have a say（有发言权）。

root: 源自古英语 secgan（说、告诉），属日耳曼语源，核心义「用话语表达」。

sensesIntro.en: Say means to speak, to show in writing, to give an example, or to have a right to speak.
sensesIntro.cn: say 意为说话、书面表明、举例说明，或拥有发言权。

core.en: To express something in words.
core.cn: 用话语表达某事。

branches.en: The core act of speaking words.
branches.cn: 说出话语的核心行为。

branches.en: Words on a sign or page speaking to readers.
branches.cn: 标牌或纸面上的文字向读者传达信息。

branches.en: A possible case stated aloud as an example.
branches.cn: 作为例子说出的可能情况。

branches.en: The right to make one's voice heard.
branches.cn: 让自己的声音被听见的权利。

branches.en: Spoken and written words both convey meaning.
branches.cn: 口头与书面文字都传递意义。

intro.en: Say forms several common compounds and derivatives.
intro.cn: say 构成若干常见复合词和派生词。

latinIntro.en: Say is Germanic rather than Latin, so the Latin entries list related concepts only.
latinIntro.cn: say 属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，因此拉丁条目只列相关概念。

items.exampleCN: 这个想法几乎难以表达。

items.example: No one can gainsay the facts.

items.meaning: a person who predicts the future

items.example: Some things are better left unsaid.

definition_en: a place where children are taught, the time spent there, a group sharing ideas, or a group of fish
core_image: 清晨的校门口，学生背着书包鱼贯而入，上课铃正好响起
scene: 孩子们背上书包，一起去学校。The children put on their backpacks and went to school together.
sceneCN: 这里 school 是「学校」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们背上书包，一起去学校。

senses.title: A place of teaching
senses.definition: a place where children or students are taught
senses.definitionCN: 教育儿童或学生的场所
senses.example: The school opens at eight.
senses.exampleCN: 学校八点开门。
senses.why: The central modern sense is the building and institution.
senses.whyCN: 核心现代义是建筑与教育机构。

senses.title: Time spent studying
senses.definition: the time or activity of being taught
senses.definitionCN: 接受教育的时间或活动
senses.example: School starts at eight in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 上午八点开始上课。
senses.why: The place sense extends to the activity that happens there.
senses.whyCN: 场所义延伸到在那里进行的活动。

senses.title: A group sharing ideas
senses.definition: a group of people with shared ideas or methods
senses.definitionCN: 拥有共同思想或方法的一群人
senses.example: She belongs to a school of modern painters.
senses.exampleCN: 她属于一个现代画家流派。
senses.why: A school of thought is a community taught by shared ideas.
senses.whyCN: 思想学派是由共同观念维系的群体。

senses.title: A group of fish
senses.definition: a large group of fish swimming together
senses.definitionCN: 一起游动的一大群鱼
senses.example: A school of fish passed the reef.
senses.exampleCN: 一群鱼游过了礁石。
senses.why: The sense comes from a separate old word for a crowd.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项来自另一个表示群体的古老词。

intro.en: School comes from Greek skholē, leisure, through Latin schola.
intro.cn: school 源自希腊语 skholē（闲暇），经拉丁语 schola 传入英语。

items.en: Skholē meant leisure or free time used for discussion.
items.cn: skholē 意为闲暇或用于讨论的空闲时间。

items.en: Schola meant a place of learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为进行学术讨论的场所。

items.en: Scol meant a place of instruction.
items.cn: scol 意为教学场所。

items.en: School covered both the place and the activity of learning.
items.cn: school 同时指场所与学习活动。

items.en: School also means a school of thought or a group of fish.
items.cn: 现代英语中 school 还指学派或鱼群。

note.en: School is compared with similar-looking words and with words for places of learning.
note.cn: 把 school 与形近词以及表示学习场所的词作比较。

entries.definition: a school or society for study
an organization for study or research

normalIntro.en: School is the place, schooling is the experience, and scholar is the person.
normalIntro.cn: school 是场所，schooling 是经历，scholar 是人。

normal.en: Go to school takes no article before school.
normal.cn: go to school 中 school 前不加冠词。

normal.en: A school of fish swims as one group.
normal.cn: a school of fish 指一群一起游动的鱼。

normal.en: A school of thought is a shared set of ideas.
normal.cn: school of thought 指共享的一套思想。

normal.en: Scholar and school share a Greek root.
normal.cn: scholar 与 school 共享希腊词根。

normal.en: Schooling means the education received at school.
normal.cn: schooling 意为在学校接受的教育。

abstract.en: School began as leisure, because learning needed free time.
abstract.cn: school 最初与闲暇有关，因为学习需要空闲时间。

abstract.en: A place, an activity, and a community all share one word.
abstract.cn: 场所、活动与群体共用一个词。

abstract.en: Even a group of fish is a kind of crowd.
abstract.cn: 连鱼群也是一种群体。

examples.en: She teaches at a village school.
examples.cn: 她在一所乡村学校教书。

examples.en: We have no school during the holiday.
examples.cn: 假期里我们不上课。

examples.en: The two writers belong to the same school.
examples.cn: 这两位作家属于同一个流派。

dict_mnemonic.text: school 源自希腊语 skholē（闲暇、讨论），古人把闲暇用于学习讨论，词义后来变成「学校」。

root: 源自希腊语 skholē（闲暇、讲学），经拉丁语 schola，核心义「用于学习讨论的场所与活动」。

sensesIntro.en: School means a place of teaching, the time spent studying, a group with shared ideas, or a group of fish.
sensesIntro.cn: school 意为教学场所、上学时间、思想流派，或鱼群。

core.en: A place and activity organized around learning.
core.cn: 围绕学习组织起来的场所与活动。

branches.en: The building where students learn.
branches.cn: 学生学习所在的建筑。

branches.en: The activity and time of being taught.
branches.cn: 接受教育的活动与时间。

branches.en: A community of shared thought.
branches.cn: 共享思想的群体。

branches.en: A crowd of fish moving together.
branches.cn: 一起移动的鱼群。

branches.en: The place and the schedule of study depend on each other.
branches.cn: 场所与学习安排相互依存。

intro.en: School forms words for students, teaching, and school buildings.
intro.cn: school 构成表示学生、教学与校舍的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola and Greek skholē are the sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola 与希腊语 skholē 是词源。
